item.title: ACC opens training center for trades in Lockhart
item.description: The new Austin Community College (ACC) Training Center in Lockhart had its grand opening on Thursday and already has hundreds enrolled.

item.title: Last day to register to vote for Texas primary is Monday
item.description: The Texas Secretary of State is reminding Texans the last day to register to vote in the March primary election is Monday.

item.title: Jasmine Crockett, James Talarico in dead heat in Texas’ Senate Democratic primary, new poll finds
item.description: The survey of likely Democratic voters suggests the March 3 primary is a toss-up less than three weeks out from early voting.

item.title: Texas cold, an East Coast storm and snow in Florida? What to know ahead of weekend travel plans
item.description: January is wrapping up, and weather is fairly quiet across the country, with brutal cold east of The Rocky Mountains, little rain in Texas and another winter storm for parts of the East Coast.

item.title: ICE agreements with Texas police climb as new state law takes effect
item.description: One year into the second term of President Donald Trump, his administration’s focus on undocumented immigrants has intensified, drawing outrage in recent weeks following shootings by Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents. Protests have broken out across the country, including in Texas, where local law enforcement agencies have hurried to sign up as force multipliers to help ICE achieve its stated mission “to make your community safer.”

item.title: Austin parks see crime reduction during security camera pilot program, parks department says
item.description: The City of Austin and Austin Parks and Recreation, or APR, have been working over the past few years to enhance public safety at city parks. Part of those efforts included a multi-year pilot program that deployed trailers with security cameras to various city parks.

item.title: Owner of massage parlor in Pflugerville faces sexual assault charge
item.description: The Pflugerville Police Department said a man was arrested Wednesday on charges related to a sexual assault that occurred in October 2025.

item.title: TEA approves 22 of 24 AISD turnaround plans
item.description: The Austin Independent School District released new information about turnaround plans it submitted a few months ago.

item.title: Austin bus driver accused of shutting door on person, dragging them, affidavit says
item.description: A CapMetro bus driver was arrested and charged in connection with an October incident that resulted in a would-be passenger getting injured after the driver closed the doors on his arm, according to an arrest warrant affidavit.

item.title: Cold Weather Advisory ahead of another arctic blast
item.description: Friday will be cooler thanks to extra clouds and a cooler airmass in place, but it won't be brutally cold. -- Nick Bannin
